# Upgrade golang.org/x/crypto to v0.56.0

## Requirements

- Apply the same dependency update pattern as PR #408, but upgrade `golang.org/x/crypto` to v0.56.0.
- Refresh Go module metadata and checksums.
- Validate the dependency update.

## Additional comments from user

- Problem statement: "https://github.com/Azure/fleet-networking/pull/408 same by to v0.56 now"

## Plan

### Phase 1: Dependency update

1. [x] Update the `golang.org/x/crypto` requirement to v0.56.0.
   - Success criteria: `go.mod` resolves `golang.org/x/crypto` at v0.56.0.
2. [x] Refresh module metadata.
   - Success criteria: `go.sum` contains the checksums for v0.56.0 and no stale selected version remains.

### Phase 2: Validation

3. [x] Run relevant Go validation for the module update.
   - Success criteria: validation passes or any environment-specific failures are documented.
4. [x] Scan modified files for secrets and run CodeQL security review.
   - Success criteria: no actionable secret-scanning or security findings remain.

## Decisions

- Use Go module tooling to resolve the requested version and generate canonical checksums.
- Limit changes to module metadata and this breadcrumb unless validation identifies a compatibility issue.
- PR #408 is the reference for the expected dependency-update pattern.

## Implementation Details

- Updated `go.mod` and `go.sum` using `go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.56.0` followed by `go mod tidy`.
- `go vet ./...` passed.
- A direct `go test -v ./cmd/... ./pkg/...` run failed because the default envtest path `/usr/local/kubebuilder/bin/etcd` was unavailable in this environment.
- `make local-unit-test` installed/used the repository envtest setup and passed.
- Secret scanning found no secrets in modified files.
- CodeQL security review found no analyzable code changes for CodeQL-supported languages, so no analysis was performed.

## Changes Made

- Created this breadcrumb before making the dependency change.
- Upgraded `golang.org/x/crypto` from v0.55.0 to v0.56.0.
- Refreshed `go.sum` checksums for the selected module version.

## Before/After Comparison

- Before: `golang.org/x/crypto` is selected at v0.55.0.
- After: `golang.org/x/crypto` is selected at v0.56.0 with refreshed checksums.
